ruleset.name: Enforced Apex Rules
ruleset.description: Enforced PMD ruleset for Salesforce Apex. Code Analyzer tags every rule declared here "EnforcedApexRules" (the ruleset name minus spaces), which is what the CI job's --rule-selector targets.

rule.message: Apex unit test classes should have at least one System.assert() or assertEquals() or AssertNotEquals() call
@isTest(seeAllData=true) should not be used in Apex unit tests because it opens up the existing database data for unexpected modification by tests
Hardcoded Salesforce IDs will break when deployed to a different org
Enforce CRUD/FLS checks before DML or SOQL
Avoid dynamic SOQL built from unescaped user input
Classes should declare a sharing model instead of defaulting to without sharing
Avoid open redirects built from unescaped user input
Avoid XSS from unescaped URL parameters
Avoid disabling escaping when writing user-controlled data to a page
Avoid hardcoded cryptographic keys or non-random IVs
Avoid performing DML in a class constructor
Prefer Named Credentials over hardcoded endpoint credentials
Avoid SOQL queries, DML statements, and other governor-limited operations inside loops
Avoid empty catch blocks; they silently swallow errors
